name: Should I choose an undermount or drop-in sink with new countertops?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose an undermount or drop-in sink with new countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: An undermount sink mounts beneath the countertop cutout, creating a seamless edge where food debris wipes straight into the basin. This style requires solid surface materials like quartz, granite, or solid surface to support the exposed polished edge. A drop-in (top-mount) sink drops into the opening from above, with a visible rim resting on the counter. Drop-in sinks work with any countertop material, including laminate, and are easier to replace later, but the raised perimeter rim can collect grime over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Undermount sinks offer a clean look and easy cleanup on stone counters, while drop-in sinks work with all materials and are simpler to swap out later.
